## Operating point

- Chosen on the validation split, reported on the test split.
- Model alone: threshold **0.76** -> EUR 1,226.28 per 1,000 welds on test (true-positive rate 19%, false-alarm rate 4%).
- Model + human review, at most 2 reviewers: pass below **0.52**, review from 0.52 to 0.84, fail from **0.84** -> EUR 946.87 per 1,000 welds, 31.7% sent to a person = 2849 reviews/day = 2.64 reviewers.
- Without the reviewer cap the cheapest band is 0.23 to 0.86: EUR 880.67 per 1,000, 78.7% reviewed, 6.56 reviewers.
- Ideal threshold for a perfectly calibrated model: 1.47% probability of a defect.

## Where I trained and with what settings

yolo11n.pt fine-tuned from the COCO-pretrained checkpoint on Tesla T4; 60 epochs run (up to 60, early stopping patience 20), image size 512, batch 16, seed 0, 26.9 minutes. Ultralytics 8.4.190, PyTorch 2.11.0+cu130.
